meta.name: skypilot-multi-cloud-orchestration
meta.description: Multi-cloud orchestration for ML workloads with automatic cost optimization. Use when you need to run training or batch jobs across multiple clouds, leverage spot instances with auto-recovery, or optimize GPU costs across providers.

copy.tagline: 跨云编排机器学习工作负载并自动优化成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多云环境运行训练任务并自动节省GPU成本
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate ML workloads across clouds with automatic cost optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run training or batch jobs across multiple clouds and optimize GPU costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你编写 SkyPilot 任务配置文件，并在命令行中执行 sky launch、sky exec 等命令，从而在多个云平台（如 AWS、GCP、Azure）上自动选择最便宜的 GPU 资源运行机器学习训练或推理任务。
howto.when: 当你需要跨多个云平台运行机器学习训练或批量任务、希望使用竞价实例并自动恢复、或者想优化 GPU 成本时，可以请求 Claude 生成 SkyPilot 配置并执行相关命令。

say.text: 帮我用 SkyPilot 在 AWS 上启动一个带 T4 GPU 的任务。
创建一个使用 A100 GPU 的分布式训练任务，4 个节点。
say.note: Claude 会生成多节点配置并启动任务。

say.text: 部署一个 Llama-2 模型服务，自动扩缩容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write SkyPilot task YAML files and execute commands like sky launch and sky exec, automatically selecting the cheapest GPU resources across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure) for ML training or inference.
howto.when_en: When you need to run ML training or batch jobs across multiple clouds, use spot instances with auto-recovery, or optimize GPU costs, you can ask Claude to generate SkyPilot configurations and run related commands.

say_en.text: Launch a SkyPilot task with a T4 GPU on AWS.
say_en.note: Claude will generate YAML and run sky launch.

say_en.text: Create a distributed training job with 4 nodes of A100 GPUs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multi-node config and launch.

say_en.text: Deploy a Llama-2 model serving endpoint with autoscaling.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Sky Serve config and run sky serve up.
